slots.visualIntent: The narrator alone with a long, unresolved thought: a person sitting somewhere familiar and ordinary, turning something over in their mind without any object in frame identifying what it is about. The hesitation is real and the mood is heavy, but the material of the regret is withheld from the image exactly as it is withheld from the narration. Whatever the regret is about, the audience is not told.
slots.searchQuery: person sitting alone with a heavy unresolved thought ordinary interior

slots.visualIntent: Two stretches of ordinary life shown one after the other at the same even weight and the same level of attention: one built around continuing to work, with a person among colleagues and a working week; the other built around time spent on one's own life, with a person outdoors, travelling lightly, or doing something for themselves. Both are filmed with the same calm observational distance and neither is marked, ranked, corrected, or resolved in favour of the other.
slots.searchQuery: two ordinary lives shown in turn working week and time for oneself

slots.visualIntent: A plain piece of ordinary life lived by a young adult — someone at a kitchen table with their own coffee, on a shared balcony, at a desk early in the morning, waiting for a bus — filmed as present-tense documentary rather than as a recovered memory. The person is a stranger to the viewer and is never identified as the narrator. The framing is level and unadorned, and nothing in the image indicates that this is being judged or redeemed.
slots.searchQuery: young adult ordinary morning at home documentary natural light

slots.visualIntent: The same young person simply continuing: a stretch of ordinary time passing with nothing resolved, nothing dropped, and nothing surrendered — a held frame as the day carries on and the person is still in it. No gesture completes anything. The image deliberately supplies no object, action, or release to stand for letting go, so that the lines about having made the best choices one could and not spending the rest regretting them have no visual paraphrase to lean on.
slots.searchQuery: young person continuing ordinary morning stillness no event long take
